subject: Network demarcation, supply-chain controls, and zonal resilience — QA
messages:
From: NorthShore Bank - Security Team <security@northshorebank.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthShore Bank - Procurement <procurement@northshorebank.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Network demarcation, supply-chain controls, zonal resilience

Alex,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. As part of our vendor security review for inference platforms, please provide detailed answers to the following items so we can advance to our architecture review board:

1) A network diagram that explicitly shows control plane / data plane demarcation between customer tenancy and platform components. Include inter-region traffic paths and gateway/bastion points.

2) A supply-chain controls matrix that lists third-party components (OS/container runtime, GPU drivers, networking appliances) and the associated attestations/evidence you can provide (SBOMs, signed images, patch cadence).

3) A short threat hypotheses summary that covers: lateral movement paths, potential compromise via shared caching/KV, and fallback behavior when an edge zone loses isolation (operator failover).

4) Evidence of zonal resilience: proof you can fail a single zone without cross-tenant data exposure, including what telemetry/audit trails are produced in such events.

Can you return an initial packet by EOD Wednesday (2027-09-08)? If you have an evidence bundle, please attach or send a link to a secure share.

Appreciate it — we want to get this in front of our infra board next week.

— NorthShore Sec Team

[NorthShore Bank is a financial institution; replies may be retained for audit.]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: NorthShore Bank - Security Team <security@northshorebank.com>
Cc: NorthShore Bank - Procurement <procurement@northshorebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Network demarcation, supply-chain controls, zonal resilience

Hi — thanks for the clear list. We're compiling a focused evidence packet and I'll lead the submission. Initial notes:

- Attached: a high-level network zoning diagram (redwood_network_zoning_v1.png) and a supply-chain controls matrix draft (supply_chain_controls_matrix.xlsx). These are EVIDENCE PACKET v1.
- Threat hypotheses summary: drafting one that hits your three callouts (lateral movement, shared KV cache risk, zone-failure fallbacks).
- Zonal resilience: we'll include a recent test report and the telemetry fields we emit (audit.trace_id, asset_id, event_type, pre/post snapshot).

Kimberly / Marissa — can you review the draft attachments for anything we must redact before sending? Also need confirmation on the signed-image attestation (SBOM link) and expected DocuSign flow for the NDA addendum from procurement.

I aim to send the consolidated evidence packet by COB Wednesday. If you need a call to walk through diagrams, I can do tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachment: redwood_network_zoning_v1.png (diagram)]
[Attachment: supply_chain_controls_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthShore Bank - Security Team <security@northshorebank.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Network demarcation, supply-chain controls, zonal resilience

Alex / Marissa — quick review notes inline: 

- redwood_network_zoning_v1.png: Good. Add explicit arrow labels for "control plane API" (port 443) and "KV sync" (internal gRPC 7001). Also annotate which subnets are customer-routable vs platform-managed.

- supply_chain_controls_matrix.xlsx: Add column for "latest CVE scan date" and one for "image signature hash". For third-party GPU driver vendor (NVIDIA), include our signed-driver provenance link.

- Threat hypotheses: I'll draft a short 3-paragraph section emphasizing our continuous KV cache eviction policy and per-tenant encryption keys (KMS scopes). We should call out that shared-cache segments are salted per-tenant to prevent cache poisoning.

Marissa — can you pull the last zonal-failover runbook snippets and the telemetry sample (json) we send to customers? We should include anonymized samples not containing customer IDs.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

[Note: marking this as "for security review" — awaiting Marissa's telemetry sample before finalizing PDF]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthShore Bank - Security Team <security@northshorebank.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Sep 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Network demarcation, supply-chain controls, zonal resilience

Attaching the anonymized telemetry snippet and the runbook excerpt. I redacted customer-specific IPs and replaced them with placeholders like <TENANT_IP>. Key points to include in the response packet:

- Telemetry: audit.trace_id, operator_id (hashed), event_timestamp, pre_state_digest, post_state_digest, asset_type, region, zone_id. Example snippet included in file.
- Zonal failover behavior: operator-initiated evacuation -> KV flush to per-tenant encrypted coldstore -> rehydrate into target zone with new encryption context. We log all steps and emit an immutable event per tenant.
- Evidence: we can provide the HSM-backed key wrap attestations under NDA; otherwise we can share the proof-of-rotation schedule and KMS audit trail sample.

Sending the final assembled evidence packet to NorthShore after Alex approves the redactions.

Marissa Cole
Principal Product Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Attachment: zonal_resilience_evidence_packet.pdf (redacted, 3.7MB)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: NorthShore Bank - Security Team <security@northshorebank.com>
Cc: NorthShore Bank - Procurement <procurement@northshorebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Network demarcation, supply-chain controls, zonal resilience

Hi — sending our consolidated packet for the items you requested. Highlights below and attachments included.

Summary highlights:
- Control plane / data plane: control plane endpoints are isolated in a dedicated management VPC with egress restricted to our control plane peers. Customer inference traffic is routed through tenant-specific data planes with per-tenant subnet isolation and enforced route tables. See redwood_network_zoning_v1.png (annotated).
- Supply-chain controls: SBOMs for base images are available on request; we sign all runtime images and publish signature hashes. Third-party components (OS, container runtime, GPU drivers) are tracked in our supply_chain_controls_matrix.xlsx with CVE scan dates and image signature metadata.
- Threat hypotheses & mitigations: documented lateral movement vectors, shared-caching risk mitigations (per-tenant salted segments + eviction policy), and operator failover choreography (immutable events + rehydration audit).
- Zonal resilience evidence: attached zonal_resilience_evidence_packet.pdf includes a recent simulated zone evacuation report and the telemetry sample (anonymized).

Attachments: redwood_network_zoning_v1.png, supply_chain_controls_matrix.xlsx, zonal_resilience_evidence_packet.pdf.

Next steps: please confirm if the architecture board requires an on-site demo or a signed NDA/HIPAA addendum for HSM attestations. Procurement — we generated a DocuSign link for an NDA addendum (DocuSign:0ff3a9c2-NSB-RFI).

Happy to jump on a call to walk the diagram.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachments: redwood_network_zoning_v1.png, supply_chain_controls_matrix.xlsx, zonal_resilience_evidence_packet.pdf]
